title: GamePatchKit package configuration
description: Validates the JSON-compatible data produced by parsing a gamepatchkit.yml document (see docs/contracts/gamepatchkit-yml.md for the YAML input contract and processing order). This schema validates the parsed configuration data structure, not the YAML document itself, and is a versioned GamePatchKit deployment artifact, not a per-package generated file. The release manifest is a separate canonical JSON artifact the Packager generates from a validated configuration plus the source tree; see release-manifest.schema.json.

packageId.description: Lowercase kebab-case package identifier. Used as the artifact and manifest storage namespace.

inputRoot.description: Host filesystem source root. This is a host path, not a Core-normalized relative path, so it is not subject to the relative-path grammar used by include/exclude/group patterns and manifest file paths.

include.description: Non-empty allowlist of relative glob patterns evaluated against inputRoot. include is the only allowlist mechanism and must never be empty.

exclude.description: Glob patterns removed from the include allowlist. Always takes priority over include; there is no re-include or negation.

maxArtifactBytes.description: Maximum physical size of a file part or bundle payload. Defaults to 10485760 (10 MiB) when omitted.

defaultArtifactMode.description: Artifact mode used for the reserved 'default' group (files matched by no declared group). Defaults to 'file' when omitted.

compression.description: Package-level compression policy applied when new artifacts are created. Required so every configuration states its policy explicitly; it never governs the validity of artifacts already recorded in a prior manifest.

groups.description: May be empty: a package with no declared groups places every file in the reserved 'default' group.

globPattern.description: Core's own glob dialect only: literal characters, an in-segment '*', and a full-segment '**'. Partial '**', absolute patterns, empty segments, '.', '..', backslash, NUL, '?', character classes, brace expansion, extglob, and negation are rejected by Core's glob parser, not by this schema pattern.

codecId.description: Fixed to 'zstd' in v1. Compression level and frame options are pinned internally by GamePatchKit.Compression.NativeCompressions (see docs/plan/04-zstd-codec-adapter.md) for deterministic output and are not user-configurable, so they are not exposed as fields here.

name.description: Unique within the package. 'default' is reserved for files matched by no declared group and must not be declared explicitly.

required.description: Whether this group must be ready before activation. Has no default: every group must state this explicitly.

compression.description: Optional group-level override of the package-level compression policy. Absent means the package-level compression setting applies to this group.
